facts.text: I am looking for advice on how to improve my portrait photography skills.
I recently attended a workshop and learned new techniques for portrait photography.
I have been struggling with getting the right focus in my portrait photography.
I purchased a new 50mm prime lens online on June 15th.
I use a Nikon D5600 camera body with my 50mm prime lens.
I have been using manual focus mode lately.
I had issues with the autofocus on my old 18-55mm kit lens.
My focus issues are mostly that the subject's eyes are not sharp.
I use the "focus and recompose" technique.
I usually shoot in a studio setting with artificial lighting.
I try different aperture settings to achieve a shallow depth of field.
I plan to try the focus peaking feature and live view mode to improve focus accuracy.
I want to get a new camera bag to replace my old one that is worn out.
I have been eyeing the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW camera bag.
I have been eyeing the Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L camera bag.
I am still deciding between the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW and the Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L.
I think I will visit a camera store to see the two camera bags in person before deciding.
I am thinking about getting a new tripod to replace my old Manfrotto BeFree.
My old Manfrotto BeFree tripod is showing signs of wear and tear.
I have a good idea of what to look for in a tripod.
I want tips on how to clean and maintain my lenses.
I have been using lens cleaning tissues to wipe down my lenses.
I am not sure if there is a better way to clean my lenses than using lens cleaning tissues.
